articles.title: GLP-1 Hospitalization Savings Fail to Offset Employer Drug Costs
articles.summary: Recent analysis highlights that while GLP-1 receptor agonists successfully reduce hospitalizations, the overall net cost still fails to make financial sense for many self-funded employers. This dilemma intensifies the pressure on plan sponsors to implement stricter utilization management, prior authorization, and alternative coverage strategies to manage escalating specialty drug spend.

articles.title: Mercer Survey Shows Employers Intensify Health Benefit Cost Management Strategies
articles.summary: A recent Mercer survey reveals that employers are aggressively doubling down on health benefit cost management tactics. This trend directly impacts self-funded employers seeking innovative ways to control rising pharmacy and medical benefit expenses through strategic plan designs.

articles.title: Study Highlights Rising GLP-1 Use and Growing Access Gaps
articles.summary: A new study shows that while utilization of GLP-1 medications continues to climb, widening access gaps are emerging among different populations. This trend directly impacts self-funded employers grappling with how to sustainably manage weight-loss drug coverage and escalating specialty drug costs within their health plans.
